Fit often matters more than features, so look at the chair you'll actually use first.

So which back massage cushion works well on an office chair? It depends mostly on the chair. A seated back massager that covers the whole backrest, like the full-back and neck-to-back cushions below, needs a backrest tall and firm enough for its straps to hold it upright. A lumbar pillow with a chair strap, such as the Zyllion ZMA-13, is the most forgiving fit. If you're choosing for a shared office or an employee wellness setup where one massager may move between chairs, run the checks below on each chair it will be used on.

Couples sharing a bed usually either size for the lighter partner or buy two individual blankets rather than one oversized one — a single heavy blanket sized for two people gets uncomfortably hot and hard to move under.

A new blanket can feel heavier than expected for the first few nights. Bearaby, one weighted blanket maker, suggests choosing the weight based on your body weight and starting with shorter periods for the first few days while you get used to it.
